sloka: असह्यानि न दुःखानि वाचश्च हृदयच्छिदः ।राक्षसीनां सुघोराणां त्वत्कृते मर्षयाम्यहम् ।। ५.४०.९।।।।
transliteration: asahyāni na duḥkhāni vācaśca hṛdayacchidaḥ ।rākṣasīnāṁ sughorāṇāṁ tvatkṛte marṣayāmyaham ।। 5.40.9।।।।

translations.english: "I am tolerating this unbearable grief, and the words of the dreadful ogresses piercing my heart. Only for you.
